PRODUCT MARKETING & COMMUNICATIONS

I turn consumer insights and product benefits into stories that move people from interest to purchase.

I’m Matthew He, a product marketing and communications professional with 4+ years of experience across 4A agencies and in-house teams. My work spans consumer technology and lifestyle brands, connecting product positioning, English messaging and launch execution for international markets.

Currently, I lead communications for CASETiFY Travel. Before that, I worked on product launches at RELX and campaigns for P&G and TCL at Saatchi & Saatchi and Wunderman Thompson.

From agency life to brand building, my focus has stayed the same: define the value, tell the story, and bring it to the places where people decide.
